description: Package https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph from its tagged source, building from upstream's committed uv.lock via uv2nix (nixpkgs' tree-sitter-language-pack 1.4.1 violates upstream's <1 pin). Also ship its skills/ as code-review-graph-skills from the same data.json, and add both to llm-toolchain. Hooks deliberately not packaged/consumed for now.

comments.text: Built and smoke-tested on aarch64-darwin only (--version, build on a scratch repo, MCP initialize + tools/list). x86_64-linux/aarch64-linux evaluate under nix flake check but were not built: the tree-sitter-language-pack manylinux wheel may need autoPatchelf via the helper's overrides.

title: Package code-review-graph (CLI + MCP server) and its skills
